# Environment variable inventory

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/env-inventory.mjs. Do not edit by hand: run `node scripts/env-inventory.mjs`. -->

150 variables: 89 read by edge functions, 55 by node scripts / the browser worker, 13 by the frontend, 5 by build tooling.

- **Edge (Deno)** values are Supabase secrets: `supabase secrets set NAME=...` (read via `_shared/env.ts`).
- **Frontend (Vite)** `VITE_*` values are baked into the public bundle at build time; never put secrets there. Template: `.env.example`.
- **Node** values come from the worker host / GitHub Actions secrets.
- **Required?** is a static heuristic (see the script header): `yes` = fails loudly when unset, `default` = has a fallback, `no` = tolerated when missing.

## Model registry variables

`supabase/functions/_shared/models.ts` builds these names at runtime, so they show up below as dynamic lookups: `MODEL_FAST`, `MODEL_BALANCED`, `MODEL_DEEP`, `MODEL_SEARCH` (value `provider:model` or a bare model id), `MODEL_<TIER>_<PROVIDER>` (e.g. `MODEL_FAST_ANTHROPIC`), `MODEL_AUTO_APPLY`, and the legacy `OPENAI_MODEL_CHEAP|STANDARD|HARD`.
